issues.description: Solution for Aufgabe 09 compares Gemeinde.name to a numeric literal (12345) instead of a string. The problem statement asks for zoos in a Gemeinde named "Erlangen" (a string). This is a type/value mismatch that makes the reference solution incorrect and will confuse students: the WHERE clause as given will not select Gemeinden by name and contradicts the task requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the WHERE condition to compare Gemeinde.name to the string 'Erlangen', e.g. WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel AND Gemeinde.name = 'Erlangen'. This aligns the solution with the task and with the string datatype of the name column.
